title: POST /v1/devices/acme/abandon: the computer's order for this reservation ended without a finalized certificate (a validation that failed, a timeout before the CSR was sent). The broker frees the slot a lapsed reservation would otherwise keep for the whole window, at most policy.budget.abandons_per_label_per_window times per label and window; what it frees in that case it no longer counts for the label either. A computer that did send the CSR never calls this: a certificate may exist, and only the CT reconciliation can lift that hold.
